restock-alerts.meaning: Yes: built-in restock alerts; partly: only by watching the page for any change; no: price alerts only.

alert-channels.name: Many alert channels

blocks-app-connections.name: Blocks app connections

asks-before-connecting.name: Asks before new connections

shows-destinations.name: Shows where data goes

shows-destinations.meaning: Yes: names, countries or a map for each connection; partly: only raw internet addresses; no: it doesn't show destinations.

data-usage-history.name: Data use per app

data-usage-history.meaning: Yes: a history of data use for each app; partly: only live totals or totals for the whole computer; no: no data use figures.

protects-whole-home.name: Covers every home device
protects-whole-home.question: Can it block ads and trackers for every device on your home network without installing anything on each one?
protects-whole-home.meaning: Yes: it covers all devices on the network, including TVs and phones; partly: only devices you point to it one by one; no: it works only inside one browser or device.

per-device-rules.name: Different rules per device

per-device-rules.meaning: Yes: groups or profiles for each device or person; partly: only simple on/off per device; no: one set of rules for everyone.

encrypted-dns.name: Private encrypted lookups

encrypted-dns.meaning: Yes: encrypted lookups both to devices and to upstream servers; partly: one direction only, or through an add-on; no: not supported.

background-play.name: Plays in the background

background-play.meaning: Yes: built-in background or audio-only play; partly: only in some situations or devices; no: playback stops.

downloads-videos.name: Download videos

downloads-videos.meaning: Yes: built-in downloads of video and audio; partly: only some formats or through a separate tool; no: streaming only.

private-subscriptions.name: Private subscriptions

private-subscriptions.meaning: Yes: subscriptions are kept privately on your device or in the app; partly: only by importing or syncing from your account; no: you must use the official account.

skips-sponsors.name: Skips sponsor segments

skips-sponsors.meaning: Yes: built in (for example through SponsorBlock); partly: only through an add-on or in some versions; no: not possible.

reply-from-alias.name: Reply from the alias

reply-from-alias.meaning: Yes: replies and new emails from the alias for free; partly: replies only, or only on a paid plan; no: you can only receive.

own-domain-aliases.name: Use your own domain

own-domain-aliases.meaning: Yes: included in the free version; partly: only on a paid plan; no: only the service's own addresses.

send-files.name: Send files

send-files.meaning: Yes: files of a useful size are supported; partly: only small files or only on some setups; no: text only.

set-view-count.name: Choose how many views

set-view-count.meaning: Yes: you pick any number of views; partly: only a choice between one view and unlimited until it expires; no: one view only, fixed.

link-password.name: Extra password on link

link-password.meaning: Yes: an optional password on any link; partly: only for some kinds of content; no: anyone with the link can open it.

opened-notice.name: See if it was opened

opened-notice.meaning: Yes: a log of when it was viewed, or a notification; partly: only whether it is still available; no: you can't tell.

converts-video.name: Converts video
converts-video.question: Can it convert video files into other formats?
converts-video.meaning: Yes: video and audio files; partly: audio only, or only a few video formats; no: no video or audio.

converts-documents.name: Converts documents
converts-documents.question: Can it convert documents such as Word files and PDFs?
converts-documents.meaning: Yes: many document formats including PDF and Word; partly: only a few document types; no: no documents.

batch-convert.name: Many files at once

batch-convert.meaning: Yes: pick many files or a folder and convert them together; partly: a queue you fill one by one; no: one file at a time.

dual-pane.name: Tabs and side-by-side panels

dual-pane.meaning: Yes: both tabs and side-by-side panels; partly: one of them; no: neither.

remote-folders.name: Opens network and cloud folders

remote-folders.meaning: Yes: network shares and cloud drives built in; partly: network shares only, or via add-ons; no: only this computer's files.

torrent-support.name: Downloads torrents

torrent-support.meaning: Yes: torrents and magnet links; partly: torrent files only, or limited; no: web links only.

video-grab.name: Saves streaming videos

video-grab.meaning: Yes: built in for many sites; partly: only some sites, or needs an extra download; no: not possible.

schedule-downloads.name: Scheduled downloads
schedule-downloads.question: Can you set downloads to start or stop at a set time?
schedule-downloads.meaning: Yes: a built-in scheduler; partly: only a speed limit or shut-down-when-done option; no: no scheduling.

send-far-away.name: Sends beyond your Wi-Fi

send-far-away.meaning: Yes: to any device over the internet; partly: only to devices paired earlier, or with extra setup; no: same network only.

disk-map.name: Shows what fills your disk

disk-map.meaning: Yes: a visual map or tree of sizes; partly: a simple list of big files; no: no size overview.

find-duplicates.name: Finds duplicate files

find-duplicates.meaning: Yes: finds exact and similar copies, like near-identical photos; partly: exact copies only; no: no duplicate search.

junk-cleaner.name: Clears junk and caches
junk-cleaner.question: Can it find and delete temporary files, caches and browser leftovers for you?
junk-cleaner.meaning: Yes: ready-made cleaning for many apps; partly: you set up your own cleanup steps; no: no junk cleaning.

secure-shred.name: Shreds files for good
secure-shred.question: Can it delete files so they can't be recovered?
secure-shred.meaning: Yes: built-in secure delete; partly: only for some items, or through another tool; no: normal delete only.

encrypts-cloud-files.name: Locks cloud storage files
encrypts-cloud-files.question: Can it lock files you keep in Dropbox, Google Drive or similar before they are uploaded?
encrypts-cloud-files.meaning: Yes: works directly inside your cloud folder; partly: you lock files by hand and then upload them; no: not designed for cloud storage.

encrypts-whole-drive.name: Locks a whole drive
encrypts-whole-drive.question: Can it lock an entire disk or USB stick, like BitLocker?
encrypts-whole-drive.meaning: Yes: whole drives and USB sticks; partly: only a container file that acts like a drive; no: single files or folders only.

auto-rules.name: Sorts by your rules
auto-rules.question: Can you set rules, like file type or date, that move and rename files for you?
auto-rules.meaning: Yes: rules for moving, renaming and deleting; partly: only a few simple actions; no: you sort files by hand.

watches-folders.name: Runs by itself

watches-folders.meaning: Yes: watches folders and acts right away; partly: only on a timer you set up yourself; no: you must start it each time.

tags-files.name: Tags on files

tags-files.meaning: Yes: tags and searching by tag; partly: tags without search, or colours only; no: no tags.

password-archives.name: Password-protected archives

password-archives.meaning: Yes: strong encryption, including hiding file names; partly: a password but file names stay visible; no: no passwords.

makes-rar.name: Creates RAR files

makes-rar.meaning: Yes: creates RAR files; partly: only through a separately installed tool; no: opens RAR only.

preview-renames.name: Preview before renaming

preview-renames.meaning: Yes: a live list of old and new names; partly: a dry run you have to start separately; no: renames straight away.

undo-rename.name: Undo a rename

undo-rename.meaning: Yes: one-step undo; partly: only right after, or by reloading a saved list; no: no undo.

reads-metadata.name: Uses photo and music details

reads-metadata.meaning: Yes: photo dates and music tags; partly: one of these; no: file names and numbers only.

preview-documents.name: Previews documents

preview-documents.meaning: Yes: PDFs and Word, Excel and PowerPoint files; partly: PDFs or plain text only; no: no documents.

preview-media.meaning: Yes: video and audio; partly: one of them, or few formats; no: images and text only.

preview-archives.name: Looks inside zip files

preview-archives.meaning: Yes: lists the contents; partly: only some archive types; no: not possible.

search-inside-files.name: Finds words inside files

search-inside-files.meaning: Yes: inside text files, PDFs and Office documents; partly: plain text files only; no: file names only.

sharex-upload.name: Works with screenshot tools

sharex-upload.meaning: Yes: ready-made setup for ShareX and others; partly: possible with manual setup; no: browser uploads only.

albums.name: Albums and galleries

web-remote.name: Control from a web page

web-remote.meaning: Yes: a built-in web page; partly: only through an add-on or separate program; no: only on the computer itself.

search-torrents.name: Built-in torrent search

search-torrents.meaning: Yes: built-in search across sites; partly: through a plugin; no: you find torrents elsewhere.

model-browser.name: Built-in model downloads

model-browser.meaning: Yes: a built-in list to browse and download models with one click; partly: download by typing a model name or link; no: you find and download model files yourself.

makes-images.name: Makes pictures too

makes-images.meaning: Yes: image creation built in; partly: only with extra setup or add-ons; no: text only.

chat-with-files.name: Chat with your files

uses-your-logins.name: Uses your logged-in accounts

highlights-passages.name: Shows which parts look AI-written

highlights-passages.meaning: Yes: highlights individual sentences or words; partly: a score per paragraph or section; no: one score for the whole text.

checks-code.name: Checks computer code

checks-code.meaning: Yes: designed to check code; partly: works on code but not made for it; no: ordinary text only.

wake-word.name: Wake word

wake-word.meaning: Yes: a wake word built in; partly: only with extra setup or hardware; no: you must press a button or type.

smart-home-control.name: Controls smart home devices

smart-home-control.meaning: Yes: built in, or through a ready connection to a smart home app such as Home Assistant; partly: only with your own scripts; no: not possible.

audio-overview.name: Podcast-style summaries

auto-quality-scoring.name: Automatic quality scoring

auto-quality-scoring.meaning: Yes: test sets and automatic scoring built in; partly: manual scores or basic checks only; no: logging only.

prompt-versions.name: Prompt version history

prompt-versions.meaning: Yes: prompt library with versions and rollback; partly: saving prompts without versions; no: not offered.

open-trace-standard.name: Uses the open tracing standard

open-training-data.name: Training data published

rolling-updates.name: Always-latest updates

ocr-languages.meaning: Yes: more than 20 including non-Latin; partly: a few languages or extra downloads; no: English or one language only.

text-from-files.name: Reads image files
text-from-files.question: Can it pull text from image files you open or drop in, not just from the screen?
text-from-files.meaning: Yes: images and files like PDFs; partly: images only; no: screen only.

per-app-volume.name: Volume per app
per-app-volume.question: Can you set a different volume or sound for each app?
per-app-volume.meaning: Yes: volume and effects per app; partly: volume per app only; no: one setting for everything.

mic-effects.name: Improves your microphone
mic-effects.question: Can it also clean up your microphone, for example removing background noise?
mic-effects.meaning: Yes: microphone effects built in; partly: basic microphone volume only; no: speakers only.

headphone-correction.name: Headphone sound profiles
headphone-correction.question: Can you load ready-made sound profiles that correct your specific headphones?
headphone-correction.meaning: Yes: built in or imports common profiles; partly: by typing settings in by hand; no: no.

separate-logins.name: Separate logins per app
separate-logins.question: Does each web app keep its own logins, separate from your main browser?
separate-logins.meaning: Yes: every app is separate; partly: optional or shared between apps; no: shares your browser's logins.

browser-choice.name: Choose the browser
browser-choice.question: Can you pick which browser powers the app window?
browser-choice.meaning: Yes: several browsers; partly: two; no: fixed.

drag-to-snap.name: Drag to snap
drag-to-snap.question: Can you snap a window into place by dragging it to an edge or zone?
drag-to-snap.meaning: Yes: built in; partly: limited zones; no: keyboard only.

custom-layouts.name: Your own layouts
custom-layouts.question: Can you design your own window layouts beyond halves and quarters?
custom-layouts.meaning: Yes: a layout editor; partly: by editing settings or a few presets; no: fixed positions only.

own-workspaces.name: Extra workspaces
own-workspaces.question: Does it give you several workspaces to switch between with a key?
own-workspaces.meaning: Yes: its own workspaces built in; partly: uses the system's desktops with limits; no: no.
